import os
from datetime import datetime
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader
from pypdf.generic import DictionaryObject, NameObject, ContentStream

W, H = 612, 792

def font_resources():
    fonts = {}
    for tag, base in (("F1", "/Helvetica-Bold"), ("F2", "/Helvetica")):
        fonts[NameObject("/" + tag)] = DictionaryObject({
            NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
            NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
            NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject(base),
        })
    return DictionaryObject({NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject(fonts)})

def approx_width(text, size, font):
    factor = 0.55 if font == "F1" else 0.5
    return factor * size * len(text)

def add_text_page(writer, items, resources):
    page = writer.add_blank_page(width=W, height=H)
    parts = []
    for (x, y, size, font, text) in items:
        safe = text.encode("latin-1", "replace").decode("latin-1")
        parts.append(f"BT /{font} {size} Tf {x:.1f} {y:.1f} Td ({safe}) Tj ET")
    content = "\n".join(parts).encode("latin-1")
    cs = ContentStream(content)
    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = cs
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources
    return page

def centered_x(text, size, font):
    return (W - approx_width(text, size, font)) / 2.0

base = os.getcwd()
cover = os.path.join(base, "cover.pdf")
report = os.path.join(base, "report.pdf")
out = os.path.join(base, "report_with_cover.pdf")

# 1) Create placeholder report body if missing
if not os.path.exists(report):
    w = PdfWriter()
    res = font_resources()
    items = [
        (72, 720, 22, "F1", "Annual Financial Report"),
        (72, 690, 12, "F2", "Report body (placeholder content)."),
        (72, 670, 12, "F2", "This document was generated because no report.pdf was present."),
    ]
    add_text_page(w, items, res)
    with open(report, "wb") as f:
        w.write(f)
    print("Wrote placeholder report body:", report)

# 2) Create cover page
w = PdfWriter()
res = font_resources()
title = "Annual Financial Report"
date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%B %-d, %Y")
print("Cover date used:", date_str)
add_text_page(w, [(centered_x(title, 32, "F1"), 500, 32, "F1", title)], res)
page = w.pages[0]
existing = page[NameObject("/Contents")]
merged = ContentStream(existing.get_data() + b"\n" + b"0.4 g 2 w 156 470 m 456 470 l S")
page[NameObject("/Contents")] = merged
add_text_page(w, [(centered_x(date_str, 18, "F2"), 430, 18, "F2", date_str)], res)
with open(cover, "wb") as f:
    w.write(f)
print("Wrote cover page:", cover)

# 3) Merge cover + report
w = PdfWriter()
for p in (cover, report):
    r = PdfReader(p)
    for pg in r.pages:
        w.add_page(pg)
with open(out, "wb") as f:
    w.write(f)
print("Wrote merged output:", out, "pages:", len(w.pages))

# 4) Verify
r = PdfReader(out)
print("Verification:", out, "has", len(r.pages), "page(s)")
for i, pg in enumerate(r.pages):
    txt = (pg.extract_text() or "").strip()
    print("  page", i + 1, ":", repr(txt[:120]))
